description: Start dataset generation for an uploaded document that is not yet processed (status 'pending'). This CONSUMES the user's monthly page quota — one page of quota per document page. Processing runs in the background; poll get_processing_status every 10-15 seconds until it completes (typically 30 seconds to 5 minutes). Fails with 409 if the document is already processed or currently processing.

chunking.description: Chunking profile: a preset name (balanced ~400 tokens, fine_grained ~200, large_context ~800) or custom values (paid plans), e.g. {target_tokens: 256, overlap_pct: 10, strategy: 'fixed_size'}.

contextual_enrichment.description: Add an AI context header and hypothetical questions to each RAG chunk for better retrieval (paid plans). Consumes enrichment units from the monthly quota.

document_id.description: Document ID (UUID). Get IDs from list_documents.

generation_context.description: Audience/use-case steering for dataset generation (paid plans): a preset id (customer_support_bot, internal_knowledge_base, developer_docs_assistant, sales_enablement, compliance_legal) or free text like 'chatbot for hotel guests'.

name: process_document
title: Process Document
